root_cause.text: The netvsc driver allows RSS hash key programming via ethtool set_rxfh even when no RX indirection table has been allocated (which occurs when the device reports a single receive queue), leading to a hang because the RSS configuration requires a valid indirection table.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that when the device reports a single receive queue, rndis_filter_device_add() does not allocate an indirection table, and accepting RSS hash key updates in this state leads to a hang. The patch adds a check in netvsc_set_rxfh() returning -EOPNOTSUPP if ndc->rx_table_sz is zero, explicitly gating the operation on the presence of the indirection table.
